subject: Observability add-ons SKU consolidation + grandfathering request
messages:
From: Anya K. <anya@skyai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyai.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — grandfathering for current customers?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick follow up from our renewal planning workshop this morning. We looked at the new observability SKU layout in the June pricing packet and have two questions from the product + procurement side:

1) Will existing customers be "grandfathered" on current trace/retention pricing if they renew the core inference commit but do not explicitly adopt the new add-on SKUs?
2) If not, can Redwood provide a transition path (discounted migration, fixed pricing for 12 months, or usage credits) to avoid a material bump in our monthly run-rate?

I've attached a redline of the draft renewal contract and a usage report for Q1–Q2 showing our current trace/retention consumption. Procurement wants a clear pricing delta so they can model the renewal.

Anya K.
Head of Product Operations, SkyAI
anya@skyai.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: contract-redlines.pdf (PDF), usage-report-q1-q2.csv (CSV)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Anya K. <anya@skyai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — grandfathering for current customers?

Anya — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments, they were helpful. High level answers and options below. I copied Ben (sales lead) and Steph (pricing) to weigh in on concessions and contract language.

Short answer: we do not automatically keep old pricing when we introduce materially new SKU definitions, but we absolutely offer transition paths for existing customers to avoid a bill shock. Options we typically use:

- Grandfather offer: lock current trace/retention effective rates for 12 months if customer signs a 12-month addendum to the renewal (no change to core commit).
- Migration credit: one-time usage credits equal to ~2 months of incremental observability spend to help bridge the first billing cycle under new SKUs.
- Phased ramp: tiered pricing (75% of new SKU for first 3 months, 90% for next 3 months).

If you prefer, we can mix the grandfather lock + 90-day trial of upgraded dashboards/tracing at no charge. That typically helps product teams validate the new features before committing.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to confirm commercial concession (percentage or credit amount)
- Steph to prepare sample addendum language and SOW (I attached a short sample SOW for reference)
- 30 min call tomorrow to agree on a path and capture procurement language

Would 11:00 PT tomorrow work for you?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: sample-sow-observability.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anya K. <anya@skyai.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — grandfathering for current customers?

Looping in a quick commercial proposal that should get procurement to green light.

Proposed concession for SkyAI (DEAL-8341):
- Grandfather current trace & retention per-unit rates for 12 months if they renew core inference commit at current level or higher.
- In addition, apply a one-time migration credit equal to 10% of their last 12 months spend on observability (per their usage csv) to apply against the first two invoices under new SKUs.
- If SkyAI decides to adopt the new advanced dashboards + tracing add-on within the first 90 days, we waive the onboarding fee and include a single month of Premium Dashboard credits (worth ~$6k).

Rationale: preserves predictable revenue, reduces friction for procurement, and provides a clear runway for SkyAI product to evaluate feature uplift.

If procurement pushes for a deeper discount, we can extend the grandfather period to 18 months but require a 6% price protection concession (deeper commit). Final legal language will be in the addendum.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise
ben_carter@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0198

From: Anya K. <anya@skyai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyai.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — grandfathering for current customers?

Thanks Vanessa and Ben — that package looks workable and I appreciate the practical options.

Procurement asked for two clarifications before we lock the renewal:
1) Can the migration credit be expressed as a fixed dollar cap instead of a percent? If so, propose a $45,000 cap on the credit (procurement's request for modeling).
2) For the 90-day free trial of advanced dashboards/tracing — will that include full access to the new retention UI and export APIs, or is it limited to view-only? The product team needs export access to validate their monitoring pipelines.

If you can confirm both items, we can schedule the 11:00 PT call tomorrow and get legal started on the addendum.

Also: we prefer any grandfathering language to be explicit in the renewal exhibit (not just an email).

Anya K.
Head of Product Operations, SkyAI
